messages:
Maria (infra): Heads-up — Q2 hosted API capacity reconciliation. We under-forecasted APAC tail latency impact last quarter and need a short plan for buys vs leases. I ran a quick sim, attaching numbers inline.

Ajay: Can you drop the sim? want the delta vs last quarter.

Maria (infra): Paste below. This is baseline = current fleet active after autoscale, adjusted for measured APAC efficiency loss (~22%). Surge scenario = marketing campaign + seasonal retail spike (+33% tokens).

```
scenario,expected_qtr_gpu_hours,expected_avg_rps,notes
baseline,120000,1500,post-autoscale, measured APAC perf -22% (network + swap)
surge (+33%),159600,2000,peak days up to 2.7k rps, sustained bursts 4-6h/day
buffer (10%),171560,2200,buffer for rollout and evictions
```

Tariq: Oof — 159.6k GPU-hours is larger than our committed capacity for Q2 by ~32k hours right?

Maria (infra): Correct — committed reserved is ~140k. After accounting for on-demand and current leases, we still have ~31k-35k hour gap depending on which efficiency knob we turn on (prefix caching/quantization).

Leo: What's the recommended mix? Buy vs lease? Buying gives lower unit cost but slower cycle time (HW lead + rack setup). Leasing is fast but ~30-50% higher unit cost.

Jess: Also remember APAC region has rack density limits at us-west-equivalent sites; we can’t just shove more GPUs there. Might need to route cross-region which increases tail latency unless we provision edge KV cache.

Maria (infra): Proposed options (quick):
- Option A (hybrid, conservative): Buy 24 A100-equivalents (on-premizable), lease 40 H100-equivalents for burst. Covers ~45k extra GPU-hours. Lead time: buys 8-12 weeks; leases immediate. Cost delta: buy amortized ~ $0.95/hr, lease ~ $1.45/hr.
- Option B (fast scale, higher OpEx): Lease 80 H100-equivalents for entire quarter. Lead time: immediate. Cost ~ $1.5-1.7/hr effective.
- Option C (software-first): Turn on aggressive prefix caching + dynamic KV edge in APAC, squeeze 18-22% efficiency (software), then only lease ~18 units for bursts. Risk: potential quality regressions; needs evals.

Ajay: Quick numbers: if we pick Option A, incremental quarterly cost (leases) = 40 units * 24h * 90d * $1.45 ~= $125k plus amortized buy capex (finance to advise). Option B Opex ~= 80*24*90*1.6 ~= $276k. Option C opex small (~$40k) but eng time for eval + rollback complexity.

finance-bot: FYI — capital approval for buys > $350k needs exec signoff. 24 A100s estimated spend ~ $420k including racks + NRE.

Tariq: Ops concerns: if we route to other regions for APAC, we saw 15-40ms added p95 which bumped token cost due to longer context lengths on some customers. We should avoid cross-region unless KV edge is in place.

Leo: What about short-term mitigations: reduce max context length for a subset of low-priority tenants, or throttle non-critical routes during peaks? That buys time for hardware.

Jess: We already have a precedence for soft-throttles. Legal flagged some customers for SLA violations last quarter; need opt-in controls. Could do per-tenant graceful degradation.

Maria (infra): I propose: 1) immediate: enable Option C trials on 10% of traffic + conservative soft-throttle policy for non-SLA tenants; 2) procurement: start lease negotiation for 50 H100-equivalents with 3-month term (covers surge) while finance processes buy approvals for up to 24 A100s; 3) infra: stand up APAC KV edge PoC (2 nodes) to reduce cross-region penalty.

Ajay: +1 to trials, request ETA on KV edge PoC?

Maria (infra): KV edge PoC target: 3 weeks (config + smoke tests). Need a small infra task force: @Tariq, @Leo, @Jess to lead.

Tariq: I can take lead on KV edge networking. Need network ACL exceptions and a colo ticket.

Leo: I'll own capacity planning sheet updates and procurement comms. Will also start lease RFP with our partners.

Jess: I'll coordinate dev signals for quality regressions and ensure opt-in throttles are config-gated per-tenant.

ops-bot: Deploy reminder: run `./scripts/kill-stale-kv.sh` after PoC infra deploy to prevent stuck leases. :robot_face:

finance-bot: @Maria (infra) please create a CAPEX request ticket with line items for 24 A100s + racks; tag with Q2-Procurement. We will fast-track review if you include expected ROI numbers (unit cost/hr comparison + payback).

Maria (infra): Will open CAPEX ticket today with ROI calc. Leo — can you add the lease RFP draft to the capacity sheet?

Leo: On it, I'll update the sheet and ping procurement.

Maria (infra): Thanks team. If everyone agrees, I'll spin up the 10% Option C trial tonight during the low-traffic window and kick off lease RFP. Any objections?

Ajay: No objections. :thumbsup:

Tariq: No objections. Go for trial but add circuit breaker in case p95 degrades >10%.

Jess: Agreed. I'll watch evals and will abort if quality drops.

Maria (infra): Great — will report back in 48h with trial telemetry and lease RFP candidates.

Ajay: Thanks.
